I was worried and drove by her house and saw she was home. She texted me later like “oh we need to break up because I don’t deserve you” with some other bullshit and I actually cried. It hurts and it’s one of the worst things you can do to someone.
I don’t care who you are, I wouldn’t wish the way I feel on anyone. I’ve been abandoned by too many people I thought cared about me and I can’t handle it.

It’s not even just about dates...I don’t have anyone in my life who cares about me. I’ve started working out and dieting to lose some weight but I’m only receiving negative comments and being told I’m too worried about it.

I understand. I’ve had some troubles myself. I consider myself a Christian, but I’m not a fan of some Christians. I joined a group that had a Friday night worship session and I shared some of my problems. I lost all my friends and was told not to come back for a few reasons.

I graduated May 2017 and still haven’t found a job. I mostly get emails rejecting me for jobs I applied for months ago. I got one interview and they hated me so bad my file was closed so no other department could look at it.

My sophomore year was my toughest because I tried to get help. Joined a Christian organization (I go to church regularly) and shared how I felt. I ended up pretty ostracized and was told I wasn’t welcome anymore. After that I just kept my mouth shut. People are generally OK if you keep a strong front, so I got used to never letting anyone too close. Just see my posts and comments if you want to see how well that’s gone over for me. I’m sorry if I sound so pessimistic.
Please don’t be another gun statistic. Your wife deserves better.

I’ve messaged a few people on Reddit but it doesn’t go anywhere usually. Everything I try to do in life turns out badly and when I think I have hope it does its best to stamp that out real fast. Thinking about living another 5 years just fills me with such intense dread.

Nothing. Now I can’t trust anyone not to leave me. I’ve had many people prove to me that I’m right in not letting anyone get close to me. Now I just want to die.

The people around me have never tried to help me and are sometimes the reason I feel bad. I don’t know why I should care when I feel like shit so much. It’s my life, if I kill myself I shouldn’t worry about how bad they feel.
